conbody.p:
USE_LEGACY_HIVE_TIMESTAMP_CONVERSION query option
The USE_LEGACY_HIVE_TIMESTAMP_CONVERSION query option selects the fallback method for converting Parquet timestamps from UTC to local time. It applies when a file identifies its writer as parquet-mr, the CONVERT_LEGACY_HIVE_PARQUET_UTC_TIMESTAMPS query option is TRUE, and the file does not identify the conversion method in its metadata.

For such files, set this option to TRUE to use the legacy conversion method used by older Hive releases. When it is FALSE, Impala uses its newer time zone database conversion method. This option does not enable conversion by itself or affect writes. When the query time zone is UTC, the option has no effect.
When conversion is enabled, Impala selects the method for each parquet-mr file in the following order:

ol.li: If writer.zone.conversion.legacy has a nonempty value, the case-insensitive value true selects the legacy method and any other value selects the newer method. This metadata takes precedence over the query option.
Otherwise, if writer.time.zone has a nonempty value, Impala selects the newer method regardless of the query option.
If neither property has a nonempty value, Impala uses the USE_LEGACY_HIVE_TIMESTAMP_CONVERSION query option.

conbody.p: Hive 4 writes writer.zone.conversion.legacy according to its hive.parquet.timestamp.write.legacy.conversion.enabled setting. Files written using newer Hive APIs can contain writer.time.zone; older Hive files can lack both properties.

Hive's corresponding fallback setting, hive.parquet.timestamp.legacy.conversion.enabled, defaults to true, whereas the Impala option defaults to FALSE. Impala still uses the legacy method when the file metadata selects it, even if the Impala option is FALSE. The legacy conversion can be approximately 50 times slower than Impala's newer method. The results can differ for historical timestamps, depending on the time zone.

The TIMEZONE query option selects the local time zone for the conversion; if unset, Impala uses the coordinator's default time zone. The writer.time.zone metadata does not set the query's time zone. To reproduce Hive's values, select the time zone used when Hive wrote the file.

For INT96 timestamps, the CONVERT_LEGACY_HIVE_PARQUET_UTC_TIMESTAMPS option enables UTC-to-local conversion for parquet-mr files. For INT64 timestamps, the Parquet schema determines whether conversion is necessary. When conversion is necessary in a parquet-mr file and CONVERT_LEGACY_HIVE_PARQUET_UTC_TIMESTAMPS is TRUE, the same method selection applies.
